The new article is NOT orphaned: the off-the-plan-sales category went 3 -> 4 and the category union 66 -> 67. Two days running, articles have shipped with their internal linking already in place.

GOOD NEWS 2 - TRAFFIC QUALITY IMPROVED FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE SCAN: Organic Search added 11 sessions (141 -> 152) against Organic Social's 3 (145 -> 148). For the first time since the outage, Organic Search has overtaken Organic Social on session count. Average engagement time jumped 36s -> 51s.

It now hides 70 of 77 articles.
This is the largest remaining on-site defect, it is entirely within the team's control, and nobody has touched it in nine days.

This is ONE content cluster that was never attached to a category, not ten scattered mistakes - which makes it a single, small job.
